correctness.rationale: The restricted language is factorial. Every new violation created by appending one letter must contain a new suffix factor. The first engine checks all square suffixes and every restricted formula-fragment suffix of lengths 4 through 7; the second engine directly scans each candidate for every square factor and all 3834 allowed morphisms. The engines agree level-by-level through length 46, giving 18 survivors at length 45 and none at 46. Direct boundary rechecks and an exact symmetry computation certify two orbits of sizes 6 and 12.

value.rationale: The bounded occurrence condition is not an arbitrary slice: it is the explicit finite certificate used in the published proof that the palindromic pattern ABCADACBA has avoidability index 4.
